raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Motivation

Move Muse Spark unified-memory coverage from `extra-b-test-4-gpu-b200` to the existing `extra-b-test-8-gpu-b300` suite.

## Modifications

- Register `test_muse_spark_unified_memory.py` on `8-gpu-b300` in `extra-b`, retaining its TP4/EP4 configuration and accuracy coverage.
- Move the matching `HF_MUSE_SPARK_TOKEN` routing in the shared PR workflow and manual rerun workflow to B300. Manual reruns retain the existing restriction on PR head SHAs.

## Accuracy Tests

- The repository's CI registry collector resolves the test to `extra-b-test-8-gpu-b300` and confirms it is enabled.
- All applicable pre-commit checks passed for the three changed files, including YAML syntax and CI registration validation.
- GPU end-to-end tests were not run locally.

## Speed Tests and Profiling

Not applicable: this changes CI scheduling and credential routing, with no inference configuration changes.

## Checklist

- [x] Format code with pre-commit.
- [x] Check CI registration using the existing collector; no new unit test is needed for this scheduling change.
- [x] Documentation changes are not applicable.
- [ ] Run GPU accuracy coverage in CI.
- [x] Follow SGLang code style.
